messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: packaging/credits — need a one-liner we can paste into the notes about what happens on plan change.

matt: One-liner: quotas and rate limits follow your active plan once provisioning completes; account-level credits and temporary buffers persist until consumed or expired.

sophia: Addendum: promotional credits are separate buckets and do not scale up automatically on upgrade.

elaine: OK thanks. Couple of rapid clarifications: 1) If we auto-fallback to a cheaper model during contention, does the customer get billed the cheaper rate? 2) If a stream is cut mid-response, what tokens are billed?

riley: 1) Yes — billing charges the model variant that actually served the request; we log model_id in the billing breakdown. 2) Tokens are metered at flush/commit boundaries; only flushed tokens are billed.

sam: Finance note: consumed credits are never reclaimed on downgrade; refunds for unused committed capacity require review. Small refunds can be handled by support credits.

andrew: Customer-facing safety: when fallthrough would change unit price by >10% we emit an account event and a billing note; customers can opt-out of auto-fallback in settings.

billing-bot: Created BILL-612: add Console tooltip copy and an FAQ entry for plan changes + fallthrough alerts.

elaine: Perfect — I'll paste the one-liner and link BILL-612 in the all-hands notes. Thanks everyone.
